newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares close mixed, tone positive.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares close mixed, tone positive.

text.p: 1730 GMT - Shares closed mixed but the underlying tone remains positive even if interest is likely to continue focused on a handful of shares, traders said.
*Turnover was a lively 6.1 billion escudos, exceptionally high for a Monday, with traders saying activity was being boosted by end-year window dressing operations.
*"Everything points to the market continuing to rise," said one trader. The PSI .PSI20 index ended 0.04 percent higher at 4956.60 points.
*But some stocks which had performed strongly in recent sessions also came in for profit-taking, with Portugal Telecom ending 0.33 percent down at 4,205 escudos after touching a new record of 4,225.
*Sonae Investimentos also reached a new high for the year of 4,729 escudos before slipping back to close at 4,690, still 0.86 percent up on the previous close.

*Sonae was helped by the rate cut announced by the Bank of Portugal on Tuesday -- 40 basis points off its draining rate to 6.40 percent, traders said, as well as the continuing positive reaction to the group's performance over the first nine months of the year.
*Banco Totta slipped 15 escudos to 2,705 ahead of the bourse session on Tuesday to fix the privatisation price of the 13.22 percent that the government is offering.
